subject: Fix Codex UUID session transcript resolution
description: Fix the remaining /costflow attribution bug where historical Codex task claims have only a UUID session_id (for example 019eef9f-bc70-7541-8f76-379400ff71e1) and no session binding main transcript, while Codex rollout files are named rollout-<timestamp>-<uuid>.jsonl. The Codex adapter can resolve by UUID suffix, but daemon taskTranscript currently goes through sessionBindings.resolveSessionTranscriptPath(), which returns null when mainTranscript is missing and blocks the adapter. Implement a surgical fix so /costflow taskTranscript can resolve a namespaced Codex task's session UUID directly through the Codex adapter even without a session binding, then split shared rollout totals normally. Add a regression where task.session is the UUID suffix, no st.sessions binding exists, and the claim window does not overlap the snapshot session, proving resolution comes from the session id not the by-window fallback.

summary: Resolved Codex UUID-only task sessions in /costflow by routing namespaced Codex task sessions through the Codex adapter before by-window fallbacks; added route regression covering no session binding, non-overlapping snapshot window, shared rollout splitting, and catch-all subtraction. Tests passed. Commit: 320cbb29e.

Approved 320cbb29e. The change is narrowly scoped to Codex-routed tasks with anySession attribution enabled: UUID-only task.session values now resolve via the Codex adapter before broader by-window fallbacks. Regression covers no st.sessions binding, non-overlapping snapshot windows, shared-rollout splitting, and catch-all subtraction. Focused tests pass from the attempt worktree.
